fullContentHtml:
MPSC Group C Posts Online Form 2026 – Start - Complete Details

Short Information : Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) has released the notification for the Various Group C Posts ) Clerk-Typist, Tax Assistant, Industry Inspector, Technical Assistant, Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector). This recruitment has been issued for 2619 posts. The online application process for MPSC Group C Posts Recruitment 2026 has started on 27 June 2026, and candidates can apply till 17 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MPSC Group C Posts Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 25 June 2026
  • Application Start Date : 27 June 2026
  • Last Date : 17 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 17 July 2026
  • Offline Fee Payment Last Date : 20 July 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • Prelims Exam Fees :
  • General Category : Rs. 394/-
  • Reserved Category : Rs. 294/-
  • Ex-Servicemen : Rs. 44/-
  • Mains Exam Fees :
  • General Category : Rs. 544/-
  • Reserved Category : Rs. 344/-
  • Ex-Servicemen : Rs. 44/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Sarkari Result Mobile App
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is MPSC Group C Posts Online Form 2026 – Start?

MPSC Group C Posts Online Form 2026 – Start is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 17 July 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://mpsc.gov.in/home

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
